modules.title: Implementation and invariants
modules.learn: Translate a statement, track an invariant, and estimate time and integer bounds.
modules.gate: Implement a linear scan independently and explain its invariant and overflow bounds.

modules.title: Sorting, two pointers, and greedy proofs
modules.learn: Use sorted order to remove choices; justify each greedy decision with an exchange argument.
modules.gate: Explain why the greedy choice cannot hurt, rather than relying on examples.

modules.title: Prefix sums and subarray reasoning
modules.learn: Represent intervals as differences of prefixes; distinguish positive-only windows from arbitrary signed sums.
modules.gate: Explain why Subarray Sums I permits a window and Subarray Sums II needs another method.

modules.title: Binary search and ordered containers
modules.learn: Write a monotone predicate, prove its direction, and keep precise search boundaries; use ordered sets safely.
modules.gate: Derive the predicate and bounds for Array Division and test boundary cases.

modules.title: Windows and amortized analysis
modules.learn: Maintain a frequency window, then use monotonic stacks and deques; account for every insertion and removal.
modules.gate: Explain why each pointer or deque element moves only O(n) times overall.

modules.title: Elementary math and constructive thinking
modules.learn: Turn patterns into formulas; reason about parity, modular arithmetic, and a construction invariant.
modules.gate: Prove a construction covers all valid cases, and handle small impossible cases explicitly.

modules.title: Recursion and exhaustive search
modules.learn: Model a recursive state, enumerate subsets and permutations, and prune without discarding valid answers.
modules.gate: Estimate the search tree and produce a small brute-force oracle for later problems.

modules.title: Dynamic programming foundations
modules.learn: Define the meaning of a state before coding; distinguish ordered sequences from unordered combinations.
modules.gate: Explain the loop-order difference between Coin Combinations I and II, including a counterexample.

modules.title: Graph traversal and shortest unweighted paths
modules.learn: Model states and edges, explore components, restore paths, and separate BFS distance from DFS structure.
modules.gate: Restore a shortest path, justify visited timing, and reason about simultaneous arrival in Monsters.

modules.title: Scheduling and ordered-state practice
modules.learn: Maintain event order, multisets, and local changes; distinguish interval selection from resource allocation.
modules.gate: Explain equal-time tie handling and why a single update changes only a few local relations.

modules.title: DP on sequences and intervals
modules.learn: Choose sequence, interval, and weighted scheduling states; understand when binary search accelerates DP.
modules.gate: Derive a recurrence and evaluation order for an unfamiliar small DP without looking at code.

modules.title: Fenwick trees and segment trees
modules.learn: Build associative summaries, point updates, prefix searches, coordinate compression, and difference arrays.
modules.gate: Implement sum and minimum queries from memory and explain each summary identity.

modules.title: Weighted paths, DAGs, and disjoint sets
modules.learn: Choose an algorithm from edge weights and graph structure; combine topological order with DP and use DSU.
modules.gate: State when Dijkstra is valid and distinguish a graph cycle from an unreachable vertex.

modules.title: Tree foundations and binary lifting
modules.learn: Exploit unique paths; compute subtree DP, diameters, ancestors, and lowest common ancestors.
modules.gate: Explain lifting invariants and derive a tree-distance query from LCA.

modules.title: Number theory and combinatorics
modules.learn: Use sieves, prime factorization, modular inverses, factorial tables, and inclusion-exclusion.
modules.gate: Explain the assumptions behind modular inverses and handle exponent reduction edge cases.

modules.title: String foundations
modules.learn: Learn prefix-function or Z-function matching, borders, periods, and trie-based DP.
modules.gate: Derive the border fallback invariant and distinguish substrings from subsequences.

modules.title: First mixed transfer checkpoint
modules.learn: Combine familiar tools in less signposted problems. Hide this module description while attempting them.
modules.gate: For two fresh mixed problems, choose a model unaided, give a proof, and code within a realistic contest budget.

modules.title: Richer windows and range summaries
modules.learn: Maintain ranks, medians, frequencies, and composable range information.
modules.gate: Explain the state kept by each data structure and how to remove a departing window element.

modules.title: Bitmasks, meet in the middle, and DP states
modules.learn: Split exponential searches, encode subsets, and design profile and digit DP states.
modules.gate: Derive a mask or digit state without copying a template, then verify against brute force.

modules.title: Cycles, strong components, and functional graphs
modules.learn: Handle negative cycles, compress SCCs to a DAG, and separate cycles from trees in functional graphs.
modules.gate: Explain which vertices a negative cycle affects and why SCC condensation is acyclic.

modules.title: Geometry foundations
modules.learn: Use cross products, orientation, exact integer arithmetic, sweeps, and distance transformations.
modules.gate: Handle collinear points and overflow correctly and explain a hull turn test.

modules.title: Games, probability, and matrix recurrences
modules.learn: Build win/lose states, xor games, expectations, and recurrence transitions under matrix exponentiation.
modules.gate: Justify a game invariant and an expectation calculation; derive matrix state meaning.

modules.title: Lazy propagation, persistence, and tree decomposition
modules.learn: Compose deferred operations, preserve versions, flatten trees, and decompose paths or distance problems.
modules.gate: Explain assignment/addition tag composition order and the information retained by each tree decomposition.

modules.title: Euler tours, matching, and flow
modules.learn: Separate edge traversal from vertex traversal; model matching, residual networks, and cuts.
modules.gate: Explain residual reverse edges, flow conservation, and how to recover the requested output.

modules.title: Constructive and interactive practice
modules.learn: Prove constructive invariants and learn interactive protocols, flushing, query budgets, and local simulation.
modules.gate: Prove the query budget before coding; for constructions, verify output with an independent checker.

modules.title: Advanced string structures
modules.learn: Study palindrome algorithms, multi-pattern matching, suffix structures, and lexicographic enumeration.
modules.gate: Explain the maintained string invariant and the time/memory tradeoff before implementing a structure.

modules.title: Bitwise algebra and transforms
modules.learn: Study binary tries, xor bases, parity identities, and subset transforms.
modules.gate: Prove basis independence and the direction of each subset transform.

modules.title: Graph structure and offline connectivity
modules.learn: Use low-link information, graph orientations, rollback DSU, and connectivity queries.
modules.gate: Distinguish bridges from articulation points and explain rollback without path compression.

modules.title: Tree structure and graph capstones
modules.learn: Practice tree encodings, isomorphism, structural reductions, and difficult graph combinations.
modules.gate: Write a reduction and proof before selecting a data structure; split a capstone into small lemmas.

modules.title: DP optimization and mutable sequences
modules.learn: Recognize optimizable transitions and prove their assumptions; learn implicit sequence trees.
modules.gate: Show why the chosen DP optimization is valid and cross-check optimized results against a slow recurrence.

modules.title: Convolution and advanced arithmetic
modules.learn: Model polynomial products and correlations; study linear algebra, symmetry counting, and deeper arithmetic.
modules.gate: Derive coefficient meanings and bounds; explain rounding or modulus requirements.

modules.title: Counting DP and grid enumeration
modules.learn: Design combinatorial states for permutations and grids, combining counting with geometry and DP.
modules.gate: Explain exactly what is counted once, and use tiny exhaustive enumeration to check multiplicities.

modules.title: Flow optimization and assignment models
modules.learn: Turn constraints into capacities or costs, then recover a feasible optimal assignment.
modules.gate: Prove the correspondence between feasible solutions and flows; handle infeasibility explicitly.

modules.title: Advanced geometry and subarray capstones
modules.learn: Combine sweeps, dynamic summaries, and geometric reductions in less standardized problems.
modules.gate: Separate event generation, active-state maintenance, and query correctness in the proof.

modules.title: Permutation, ordering, and sequence capstones
modules.learn: Practice recovering hidden structure in permutations and sequences with mixed techniques.
modules.gate: Construct an independent checker and explain the structural observation that reduces the search space.

modules.title: Final mixed problem-solving lab
modules.learn: Tackle remaining unusual problems with model selection, small experiments, and staged proofs.
modules.gate: Produce a reusable lesson, a brute-force comparison where possible, and a fresh transfer attempt for each task.
